findings.detail: At reviewed commit c5222f7dc4da7fda73ed517c1bf1df5d872531bc, the retired local-JEV coordination boundary admits only experiments/configs/local_jev/pixi.lock and experiments/configs/local_jev/pixi.toml. Neighboring runtime.py and source-like artifact paths remain rejected. Clean source identity, ancestry, changed-path allowlisting, regular-file checks, and final state rechecks remain fail-closed.
The reviewed commit changed no native gameplay paths. The deleted Pixi files were environment and coordination metadata removed by ancestor commit 9ea844c17af423459733c615340c5587a68912ee.

Retained diagnostic and reviewer tooling remains advisory, hash-bound, and read-only with respect to gameplay authority. JEV rows remain quarantined, labels remain unset, training and action authorization remain false, and missing evidence remains unknown or unavailable.

verify_review accepts supporting_review and enforces independent identity, exact file hashes, stable rollout-prefix hashes, and JSON-only final output. build_review emits kind review unconditionally, and the requested tests do not cover supporting_review. The coordinator must explicitly bind kind supporting_review and re-run receipt verification before claiming that binding.
The tests cover the exact classifier and adjacent source-delta rejection, but do not exercise an end-to-end deletion of the retired Pixi files through verify_build_control_compatibility().

limits: The active work-unit JSON and artifact records changed by the commit were outside the immutable review set and were not inspected, so the frozen Blood permanent-enchant unit ID and coordinator-side receipt wiring were not independently verified.
No native build, server launch, live validation, or native gameplay file review was performed.
The supporting_review receipt kind was not exercised by the requested tests.
